chronology.event: Subconscious hallucination filtering already used pre-input verified-memory curation, seven post-output reality checks and a penalty fed back into PPO. This is the immediate policy/grounding precursor, not yet the NRG multi-head network.

NRG introduced as a five-module hippocampal-prefrontal-inspired grounding circuit with source/identity/familiarity/temporal/experience-related outputs, rule-based cold start and consolidation-time supervised learning.
A subsequent system snapshot persisted neural_reality_gate.db among live seed databases, showing the mechanism had durable runtime state rather than being documentation-only.
Reality-gate rules continued to evolve; frozen-head code includes fabricated-code-reference checks and a critical training-label parser fix.

findings.summary: NRG implements a compact learned grounding controller over a 60-dimensional feature vector (30 text-derived plus 30 context-derived features) with five internal modules and separate outputs including familiarity_valid. Historical file documentation reports approximately 28K parameters and <3 ms CPU, while the introduction commit says 21K parameters; preserve this as an unresolved documentation/instrumentation discrepancy rather than inventing one exact size.

The cold-start migration is explicit and staged: below 100 evaluations output is 100% rule fallback while the neural path trains silently; below 300 it is 50% rule; below 500 it is 25% rule; after 500 the historical design becomes fully neural. This is a reusable migration pattern, but step count alone is not sufficient evidence to remove a safety baseline in current FRANK.

Frozen-head code documents a critical historical bug: stored violation strings included suffix detail such as human_temporal:childhood, while auxiliary-label logic originally intersected them against bare prefixes. Before the later prefix-splitting fix, intersections were always empty and auxiliary targets were effectively all 1.0. Therefore historical multi-task neuralization cannot be assumed to have learned the intended module semantics throughout its lifetime.

Even after the parser fix, familiarity_valid auxiliary supervision is generated directly from rule violations fabricated_object/external_place. Main grounded labels are also produced when the same validation stack rejects a thought or accepts/stores it. Inference: this creates a teacher-self-confirmation/label-leakage path; the neural head can distill rule policy and its errors rather than independently establish familiarity truth. This is a causal risk hypothesis, not a measured failure rate.

NRG persists feature traces, per-head scores, confidence, rule score, violations and later outcome labels in SQLite and trains during bounded consolidation cycles. It saves model+optimizer state through an atomic temporary-file rename and restores total/training steps. This is useful lifecycle scaffolding for a candidate learner.

The inspected frozen-head NRG exposes one rolling checkpoint path, not an explicit candidate-vs-current shadow model, versioned promotion manifest, last-known-good rollback chain, independent holdout gate or open-set calibration contract. No repository search hit verified such NRG-specific rollback semantics. Therefore NRG persistence must not be credited as current MVC promotion/rollback compliance.

NRG familiarity is familiarity of textual/self/world claims against context and heuristic violation classes. It is not evidence of visual identity learning, prototype memory, sensor truth, or user-specific object recognition. The current visual MVC may reuse lifecycle/control ideas only after replacing the supervision/evidence boundary.

current_frank_mapping.recommended_discriminating_test: For H1, implement a candidate visual familiarity head beside a frozen baseline. Train only from admitted GOLD/SILVER examples; evaluate on a frozen independent recurring-user split plus realistic unknown/near-neighbor negatives; compare current vs candidate on known-class accuracy, open-set AUROC/FPR at target recall, calibration, forgetting after sequential additions, routing savings and CPU/RAM/update cost. Promote only on preregistered gates and retain atomic rollback.

branch_feedback.frank: DELTA: reuse NRG's staged learned-controller lifecycle, but keep textual grounding familiarity and visual identity familiarity separate. Never let familiarity_valid become sensor or action authority.
branch_feedback.harness: DELTA: add an anti-echo acceptance test: a candidate learner trained from its own rule-derived labels must not count as independently validated. Require frozen external/held-out labels and rollback receipts.
branch_feedback.claycode: DELTA: represent learner authority phases explicitly (BASELINE_ONLY, SHADOW, BLENDED, PROMOTED, ROLLED_BACK) with evidence-gated transitions; evaluation count may be telemetry but not sufficient transition authority.
branch_feedback.unifieddb: DELTA: persist training-label origin separately from model prediction, plus candidate/current version, holdout identity, calibration gate, promotion receipt and rollback ancestry.
branch_feedback.claygraph: DELTA: encode learned familiarity as a provenance-bearing hypothesis edge distinct from observation/evidence edges; prevent self-produced learner labels from closing their own evidence loop.
branch_feedback.gwt: DELTA: familiarity may influence salience/routing but should broadcast uncertainty and provenance with the signal; do not collapse it into grounded truth.
branch_feedback.emergenz: DELTA: if testing causal benefit, lesion/rescue the familiarity head against the same external holdout and downstream task; self-agreement is not emergence evidence.
branch_feedback.hyperposition: DELTA: unresolved known/unknown alternatives should remain set-valued until independent evidence narrows them; a learned familiarity head is one constraint, not collapse authority.
branch_feedback.clayresearch: DELTA: NRG is a historical example of useful staged neuralization plus a concrete anti-echo failure mode. Carry both into the current adaptive learner architecture.
